name: Hourly minimum prices the time, servings not added on top
why: Kiddie Academy - Roland Park, 2026-07-25. Confirmed by the finance owner:
actual amount $275.00, event type Invoice, and the $250 is the PER HOUR
billing model -- 'The minimum for 1 hour will be $250'.
Three wrong readings before this. INVOICE_BASE_FEE_PLUS_SERVINGS treated the
$250 as a base fee and added servings: $316 -> $347.60. INVOICE_HOURLY added
servings on top of the hour: $338. MIN_GUARANTEE_HOURLY got $250 by luck but
would have DEFERRED the invoice forever, so the school was never billed.
Correct: INVOICE_HOURLY, HOURLY_RATE 250, TOTAL_EVENT_HOURS 1 (from the event's
own 11:00-12:00 times), RATE_PER_SERVING 0. Billed 1 x 250 = $250, +6% tax $15,
Servings are NOT billed on top: the notes price the hour, not the hour plus
every cup. The '$3 kiddie / $4 small' figures are reference pricing for what
the hour covers. Nothing is derived or invented -- an earlier attempt set
UNITS_INCLUDED_IN_BASE = 250/4 = 62.5 so a package model would produce $250,
and that fabricated quantity reached the client's invoice.
EVENT_TYPE is pinned to invoice because the notes declare 'EVENT TYPE Invoice'.
The declared field is authoritative and is now enforced in code.
open_questions: The notes quote two per-cup prices ($3 kiddie / $4 small) that this model does
not bill, so the dead-terms gate may flag them as stated-but-unused. That is a
hold for review, not a wrong invoice -- and it is arguably the right prompt:
someone should confirm the per-cup prices are reference-only for this booking.
